scope: final Vite dist in Chrome, isolated localhost backend and test users
checks: first login enters the workspace with isolated account storage
adding a second account preserves the first connection and restores the account list
inactive account receives unread messages without reading its chat history
switching restores the correct draft and authenticates sends with the selected account
saved tokens are encrypted with a nonextractable browser key and plaintext passwords are absent
refresh restores both online accounts and the active selection
canceling an extra login leaves existing accounts online
different tabs select different accounts without forcing the other tab to log out
revoking an inactive account only expires that account
reauthentication reuses the existing account entry
logging out one account preserves the other account and clears only its saved credential
multi-account runtime has no JavaScript or Vue lifecycle warnings
legacy single-account token is adopted and removed only after encrypted persistence
successful login retains its encrypted session across profile initialization failures and retry
a rejected extra login leaves the original account usable
an account added in another tab during restoration is reconciled after the in-flight restore
account management remains reachable on the mobile Web layout
native Vue login rejects invalid password and accepts valid session
conversation history and older paging
encrypted text outbox sends exactly once
reply and quote use server message identity
reload restores session and conversation
group members and permission controls
settings profile save
privacy and device settings entries
global and conversation search returns messages
image upload and protected preview load
native emoji categories preserve all original groups
pin, unpin and batch selection menus
privacy rules persist without overriding unauthorized group rule
QR code renders actual account
member cannot use owner controls
native Vue has no runtime JavaScript errors
draft text and cursor remain scoped to the original conversation
typed mention query and Enter choose a member without sending the draft
group avatar context exposes current permission checks
owner creates a group with the full candidate columns and preset avatar
media retry preserves upload results and message idempotency after a lost acknowledgement
loaded images keep the same DOM node when a new text message arrives
search result locates the target and returns to latest without losing permission
single-target forward search includes favorites and does not reload the sender
privacy extra rules can be saved as reactive state without clone errors
local lock code can be saved, used and disabled
mobile viewport retains working navigation and image rendering
no browser runtime errors during parity scenarios
